products.name: EcoShield Home Policy

products.name: FamilyHaven Comprehensive

products.name: Globetrotter Shield Deluxe

products.name: Family Voyage Secure

products.name: Business Class Coverage Pro

products.name: EcoTraveler Assurance Plan

products.name: FlexGuard Essential Disability

products.name: ProActive Plus Coverage

products.name: SelectSecure Disability Income Plan
products.description: SelectSecure Disability Income Plan is ideal for young professionals beginning their career journey, offering affordable rates and scalable benefit options. With its focus on accessibility and competitive pricing, this plan emphasizes the importance of early financial protection for emerging talent in the workforce.

products.name: SmileGuard Family Plan
products.description: SmileGuard Family Plan offers comprehensive dental coverage tailored for families looking to safeguard their oral health. With generous coverage for orthodontics and major dental work, SmileGuard ensures that both children's braces and adult treatments are well supported. Ideal for families prioritizing long-term dental wellness, this plan provides peace of mind with access to a wide network of dental providers.

products.name: BrightSmile Essentials
products.description: BrightSmile Essentials is designed for individuals and young professionals seeking basic yet effective dental care coverage. With a focus on simplicity and affordability, BrightSmile Essentials is perfect for those just starting out and needing reliable coverage without the frills. This plan provides access to a large network of dentists and guarantees you won't be caught off guard by unexpected dental expenses.

products.name: SeniorSmile Complete
products.description: SeniorSmile Complete caters specifically to the dental needs of seniors. Preventive services are fully covered, while co-pays for other treatments remain budget-friendly. SeniorSmile Complete comes with a dedicated customer support line for easy management and inquiries, making it an excellent choice for those over 60 looking to maintain a healthy smile.

products.name: YouthCare Starter Plan
products.description: YouthCare Starter Plan is tailored to the dental needs of children from toddlers to teens. products.name: EliteSmile Executive

Perfect for executives and those who value exclusive care, EliteSmile Executive also features a personal dental concierge to assist with appointments and queries. Enjoy premium care and luxury service that matches a lifestyle of distinction.

products.name: ClearSight Bronze Basic

products.description: VisionGuard Silver Plus caters to professionals and older adults who prioritize enhanced eye care services. products.name: EyeCare Platinum Elite

With access to an extensive network of specialists and the latest in vision technology, this plan ensures optimal eye health for every member, regardless of their lifestyle or vision requirements.

products.name: FocusFlex Gold Choice
products.description: FocusFlex Gold Choice is perfect for those who desire flexible, personalized vision insurance options. With customizable benefits that cater to both casual and frequent eyewear users, this plan is tailored to fit diverse needs, offering a balance of affordability and exceptional service.

products.name: OptiVision Essential Saver
products.description: OptiVision Essential Saver offers essential vision benefits at an economical price, ideal for students and young adults starting their eyewear journey. This plan covers the cost of annual eye exams and provides a basic allowance for frames and lenses. With low monthly premiums and a focus on preventive care, it ensures that members can preserve their eyesight without financial strain, supporting healthy vision habits from the start.

products.name: FurryFriend Essentials Plan
products.description: The FurryFriend Essentials Plan is designed for pet owners seeking affordable, essential coverage for their beloved companions. It covers routine check-ups, vaccinations, and common illnesses, ensuring your pet stays healthy and thriving. Ideal for first-time pet owners or those with multiple pets, this plan also offers discounts on additional pets and preventive care services.

products.name: PetSafe Elite Coverage
products.description: PetSafe Elite Coverage offers comprehensive protection for your cherished animals, including accident and illness coverage with no breed restrictions. products.name: HealthyPaws Lifelong Care

This plan includes wellness exams, dental care, and age-specific screenings to promote long-term health. products.name: Whiskers & Tails Adventure Shield
products.description: The Whiskers & Tails Adventure Shield plan is perfect for pets that love to explore and adventure. products.name: VetCare Budget Plus

It's particularly suited for budget-conscious families who want to ensure their pets receive necessary medical attention in a financially manageable way.

products.name: TechGuard Cyber Assurance

With cyber threats evolving, this insurance provides peace of mind and resilience in an increasingly digital world.

products.name: CraftCommerce Retail Shield

Allows policyholder to receive a portion of the death benefit if diagnosed with a terminal illness with a life expectancy of 12 months or less, subject to medical documentation.
Waives all future premiums if the insured becomes totally disabled before age 60 and remains so for at least six consecutive months.
Provides lifetime death benefit coverage and accumulates cash value over time. Excludes death by suicide during the first two years of the policy.
Policy accumulates cash value over time at a guaranteed minimum interest rate, which can be borrowed against or withdrawn under specific conditions.
Allows policyholders to borrow against the cash value of their policy at any time, subject to interest charges. Unpaid loans reduce the death benefit.
Provides coverage for a specified term with the option to convert to a permanent policy without additional underwriting, before a specified age or term end.
Allows policyholders to renew the term life policy at the end of the term without requiring a medical exam, though premiums will increase based on age.
Pays out the benefit upon the first death of the two insured individuals. Subsequent death is not covered unless a separate or new policy is in place.
Provides an additional lump sum benefit to the surviving policyholder to offset financial difficulties after the death of the first insured person.
Coverage is guaranteed for life with fixed premium payments. No medical exam required but subject to health questionnaire; higher premiums for smokers.
Provides a set amount to cover final expenses like funeral costs. Payable to beneficiaries upon death regardless of cause, assuming premiums are paid.

Covers emergency room visits for acute and critical conditions. A $100 co-pay applies per visit, waived if admitted.
Includes generic and selected brand-name drugs. $50 deductible applies per year. Requires use of network pharmacies.
Covers two annual checkups, cleanings, and basic dental work for children under 18. Excludes orthodontics beyond alignments.
Covers visits to specialists, laboratory testing, and minor procedures. Requires pre-approval for non-routine specialist visits.
Includes ambulance services to the nearest appropriate facility during emergencies. Air transport covered if deemed medically necessary.
Covers physical therapy, occupational therapy, and rehabilitation programs post-illness or injury. Limited to 30 sessions annually.
Covers specialist consultations upon referral by a primary care physician. Subject to plan network restrictions.
Focused on diabetes, hypertension, and asthma management, including exams, medications, and lifestyle consultations.
Unlimited access to telemedicine consultations with in-network providers. Suitable for non-emergency consultations.
Includes inpatient and outpatient treatment programs for alcohol and drug addiction. Subject to pre-authorization.
Covers essential inpatient services such as room charges, basic surgical procedures, and general nursing care. Requires approved facilities.
Offers discounted rates on prescription medications. Coverage only through partnered pharmacy networks.
Covers lab tests, X-rays, and diagnostic imaging necessary for treatment. Excludes exploratory procedures without medical necessity.
Includes unlimited virtual consultations with general practitioners. Excludes specialist telehealth services.
Covers visits to urgent care centers for non-life-threatening conditions. $50 co-pay per visit applies.
Provides coverage for all CDC-recommended vaccines for adults. Administered only by in-network providers.
Covers inpatient hospital services, surgical procedures, and specialized care. Requires pre-approval for non-emergency admissions unless admitted via emergency room.
Includes management programs for chronic conditions such as diabetes, heart disease, and arthritis. Focuses on ongoing care and monitoring.
Covers skilled nursing care and therapeutic services at home following hospital discharge, as per physician's orders.
Full coverage for generic and preferred brand medications. Requires use of plan-approved pharmacy network.
Contributes towards costs associated with assisted living facilities. Coverage includes a variety of support services.
Annual wellness exams, screenings, and routine tests are fully covered to help maintain health and prevent disease.
Offers flexible coverage options for outpatient procedures and services. Pre-authorization required for specialized services.
Includes annual exams and recommended vaccinations. Covered entirely when rendered by in-network providers.
Covers annual eye exams and offers discounts on corrective lenses and eyewear through partnered opticians.
Includes coverage for acupuncture and chiropractic services. Subject to plan limits and certified practitioners only.
Covers routine dental exams, cleanings, and X-rays. Major procedures excluded unless added as supplemental coverage.
Access to fitness programs, weight loss programs, and smoking cessation support. Requires registration in approved programs.

Covers damages to the vehicle resulting from a collision with another vehicle or object. Excludes damages resulting from racing or off-road use. Coverage is applicable only if the vehicle was operated by an authorized driver.
Includes coverage for non-collision incidents such as theft, fire, and vandalism. Excludes wear and tear, mechanical failures, and damage due to rodents. There is a $500 deductible per incident.
Provides medical expenses coverage for the driver and passengers in the event of an accident. Excludes injuries sustained while committing illegal activities. No deductible applies.
Offers 24/7 roadside assistance for towing, flat tires, fuel delivery, and lockouts. Coverage is limited to five incidents per policy year. No deductible applies.
Provides reimbursement for rental car expenses in the event of a covered accident. Maximum of $50 per day for up to 10 days. Applies only if the insured vehicle is inoperable due to a covered event.
Covers bodily injury and property damage caused by an uninsured driver. Excludes incidents where the insured is at fault. No deductible applies.
Covers repair or replacement of vehicle glass due to chips or cracks. Deductible waived if the glass is repaired rather than replaced. Limited to two claims per policy year.
Provides funds towards a new eco-friendly vehicle if the insured vehicle is totaled. Applicable for hybrid or electric vehicles only. Reimbursement limited to 80% of the replacement vehicle's value.
Contributes to carbon offset programs on behalf of the insured driver annually. Participation is contingent upon maintaining a low mileage below 10,000 miles per year.
Extends the warranty on hybrid vehicle batteries for an additional two years beyond the manufacturer's warranty. Does not cover damage due to improper maintenance or use.
Covers damages to home charging stations for electric vehicles. Excludes damage due to natural disasters or negligence. Deductible applies per claim.
Covers the use of recycled or remanufactured parts for vehicle repairs. Deductible applies per repair. Not applicable to parts compromising vehicle safety or performance.
Waives the first at-fault accident surcharge for drivers of hybrid or electric vehicles. Eligible drivers must have a clean driving record for three years prior.
Provides discounts based on safe and environmentally-friendly driving habits monitored through a telematics device. Program participation required; discounts applied at policy renewal.
Covers damages to the vehicle in the event of a collision within city limits. Excludes accidents occurring on highways. Deductible applies per incident.
Reimburses up to $300 per year for public transit fares incurred when the insured vehicle is undergoing repair due to a covered claim. Valid receipts required for reimbursement.
Provides coverage for theft or vandalism of the vehicle in urban settings. Excludes parked vehicles left unattended for over 48 hours in unauthorized areas. Deductible applies.
Liability coverage for accidents involving pedestrians where the insured is at fault. Excludes incidents occurring while under the influence of alcohol or narcotics.
Provides 24/7 roadside assistance in urban areas for issues such as breakdowns or flat tires. Limited to three incidents per policy year; coverage does not extend to rural or remote locations.
Covers damages incurred while the vehicle is parked in authorized city parking zones. Excludes damages from natural disasters. Deductible applies per claim.
Forgives the first at-fault accident for young drivers under 25 years old. Drivers must have maintained a clean record for one year prior. Surcharge penalties are waived.
Offers premium discounts for completing a certified driver education program. Certification must be provided, and the discount is applied at the next policy renewal.
Provides a premium discount for maintaining a B average or higher in school. Valid for full-time students only; verification required each policy term.
Covers theft or damage to laptops and smartphones stored in the vehicle. Excludes claims if the vehicle was unlocked. Deductible applies per incident.
Annual rewards for young drivers with no accidents or violations. Bonuses are applied as credit towards policy renewal. Eligibility reviewed annually.
Complimentary roadside service for towing, jump-starts, and flat tires. Limited to four incidents per year. Not available for off-road incidents.
Covers damages to a friend's or peer's vehicle while being driven by the insured. Excludes coverage if alcohol or drugs are involved in the incident.
Covers damages to farm equipment during transport by the insured vehicle. Excludes equipment not securely fastened or exceeding the vehicle's load capacity.
Insures livestock being transported for injury or death due to an accident. Excludes improper handling or transport exceeding legal vehicle limits.
Covers theft or vandalism of the vehicle when parked in rural areas. Excludes vehicles left unattended for over 72 hours in unsecured locations.
Protection against damage from natural events like hail or flooding. Coverage excludes pre-existing damage or claims attributed to neglect.
Liability protection for accidents occurring off recognized roadways. Applies to personal use only; commercial use exclusions apply.
Covers clean-up costs and penalties for accidental fuel spills from transport tanks. Excludes intentional releases or spills resulting from negligence.
24/7 roadside assistance for breakdowns or flat tires within rural areas. Limited to three service calls per policy year. No urban coverage included.
Covers physical damage to the home structure including walls, roof, and foundation from perils such as fire, wind, and hail. Excludes damage from earthquakes and floods.
Covers theft or damage to personal belongings within the home. Excludes high-value items over $2,500 unless separately scheduled.
Provides protection against legal claims for bodily injury or property damage that the insured is legally responsible for. Does not cover intentional acts.
Reimburses additional living expenses incurred if the home becomes uninhabitable due to a covered loss. Subject to a 12-month maximum period.
Pays for medical expenses of guests injured on the insured premises, regardless of fault. Excludes injury to residents of the home.
Provides protection for home office equipment used for business purposes. Must be located in the insured dwelling; excludes data loss.
Covers direct physical loss to the home caused by water backing up from drains or overflow of a sump. Excludes gradual damage and seepage.
Provides reimbursement for expenses incurred as a result of identity theft. Includes legal fees and lost wages, subject to policy limits.
Covers structural damage from covered perils like fire and major storms. Excludes earthquake and flood damage.
Covers loss or damage to belongings caused by perils like theft and vandalism. Jewelry and electronics above $2000 need additional riders.
Coverage for legal expenses if the insured is responsible for bodily injury or property damage. Excludes business-related liabilities.
Covers additional costs of living elsewhere while home is repaired due to a covered loss. Limited to 6 months maximum.
Pays for guest medical bills if they are injured on your property, regardless of fault. Does not cover household members.
Covers increased costs to repair or rebuild due to changes in local building codes. Does not apply to undamaged parts of the property.
Provides protection from damage caused by severe weather events excluding normal wear and tear. Excludes flooding and earthquakes.
Covers damage to home from covered ecological risks such as wind and fire. Excludes flood and earthquake damage.
Covers damage or loss of personal items due to covered perils. Includes coverage for eco-friendly appliances at full replacement cost.
Protects against liability claims for bodily injury or property damage. Legal defense costs are included within limits.
Reimburses temporary living expenses while home is uninhabitable due to covered loss. Limited to a 9-month period.
Covers additional costs incurred to upgrade to eco-friendly materials during repairs. Does not cover entirely new constructions.
Pays for medical expenses if a third party is injured on the insured's property. Excludes injuries caused by animals owned by the insured.
Covers replacement of energy-efficient or eco-friendly appliances damaged by a covered peril. Not applicable to appliances older than 10 years.
Coverage includes damage from fire, storms, and vandalism. Earthquake and flood damages require separate policies.
Covers personal items against theft, fire, and other perils. High-value items over $5,000 require documentation for full coverage.
Protection against legal claims for injuries or damages to others. Covers legal defense costs, but not punitive damages.
Reimburses additional costs if the insured must relocate temporarily while the home is repaired. Maximum coverage is 12 months.
Covers medical expenses for guests injured on the property. Does not cover injuries from recreational equipment like trampolines.
Reimburses costs associated with restoring identity after theft, including legal expenses and credit monitoring. Limited to two claims per policy term.
Provides coverage for cyber-attacks on home networks, including data recovery and legal fees. Excludes business losses.
Covers repair or replacement of major systems and appliances due to mechanical failure. Excludes wear and tear and obsolete equipment.
Provides financial coverage for structural damage from covered events. Flood and earthquake damages are not covered without additional riders.
Covers the loss or damage of personal items. Must document belongings over $10,000 for full coverage, or payout may be limited.
Protects against lawsuits for injury or property damage caused by the insured. Includes legal defense costs within policy limits.
Covers temporary relocation costs if the home is uninhabitable due to a covered loss. Coverage extends up to 18 months.
Pays for medical expenses of guests who are injured on the property, regardless of fault. Excludes injuries from pets.
Provides increased protection for antiques and collectibles against damage or theft. Appraisal needed for items valued over $25,000.
Covers damages from flooding, separate from standard perils. Subject to a 30-day waiting period unless coverage is required for a loan.
Protects against damage from wildfires. Includes optional preventative measures like home-hardening features and fire-resistant materials.
Covers non-refundable prepaid travel expenses if the trip is cancelled due to illness, injury, or death of the insured or a family member. Excludes cancellations due to known or foreseeable events.
Covers medical expenses incurred due to an illness or accident while traveling. Excludes pre-existing conditions and elective procedures.
Covers the cost of personal belongings lost during transit. Does not cover electronics or high-value items separately insured.
Compensates additional expenses incurred due to a travel delay of more than 6 hours. Covers meals and accommodations up to a daily limit.
Covers transportation to the nearest adequate medical facility in case of a medical emergency. Prior approval required for non-emergency evacuation.
Provides a lump sum in case of accidental death or covered loss of limb sight while traveling. Limited to accidents occurring during the insured trip.
Covers costs due to damage or theft of a rental car. Collision coverage only; does not cover liability or personal injury.
Covers costs incurred if a missed connection due to a delay causes a traveler to miss a subsequent leg of their trip.
Covers medical expenses for the entire family for illnesses or accidents occurring while traveling. Excludes pre-existing family conditions.
Protects against loss of non-refundable family trip costs due to covered events such as illness or death in the family.
Reimburses costs for childcare services if parents are hospitalized during the trip. Maximum coverage per child applies.
Covers additional costs incurred by the family due to a delay in travel plans, exceeding 6 hours. Includes meals and accommodations.
Provides services to assist with identity theft recovery during travel. Includes legal and personal assistance with no dollar limit on services.
Provides financial support to beneficiaries in the event of accidental death or dismemberment of a family member during authorized travel.
Covers pet boarding fees if a trip delay causes extended absence from home. Does not cover pre-existing conditions of the pet.
Covers loss or damage to business equipment such as laptops and projectors while traveling. Requires police report for theft claims.
Covers non-refundable costs if a business meeting is cancelled due to unavoidable circumstances. Covers rescheduling fees as well.
Reimburses additional business expenses for delays over 4 hours, including accommodation and essential communication expenses.
Provides legal support and bail expenses if required due to business-related disputes or legal issues arising during travel.
Covers financial loss due to business interruptions caused by unforeseen events like natural disasters affecting business continuity.
Covers travel and accommodation costs for an immediate replacement should an insured employee become unfit to continue their duties.
Reimburses costs incurred due to client-initiated deferrals of meetings or projects. Excludes deferrals due to contract breaches by the insured.
Provides full reimbursement for public transportation costs if eco-friendly alternatives are used instead of car rentals.
Covers cost differential when choosing eco-certified lodgings. Must provide proof of certification upon claim.
Reimburses costs associated with purchasing carbon offsets for flights and other travel-related emissions. Requires proof of purchase.
Covers loss or damage to luggage made of at least 60% recycled materials. Claimable once per policy period.
Provides financial assistance for eco-friendly recovery efforts if a natural disaster affects travel plans. Excludes man-made events.
Reimburses travel costs for volunteer projects with registered environmental organizations. Requires prior approval and proof of activity.
Reimburses the cost difference when choosing sustainable dining options. Requires receipts and documentation of sustainability claims.
Covers non-refundable hostel costs if the trip is cancelled due to covered reasons such as illness or travel advisories.
Provides coverage for budget airline tickets cancellation due to covered events. Excludes voluntary cancellations.
Covers legal liability for injury or damages to third parties while backpacking. Excludes intentional acts or illegal activities.
Covers accidents or injuries occurring during common backpacker adventure activities such as hiking and rock climbing. Excludes extreme sports.
Covers costs for replacement of lost or stolen travel documents, including passports and visas. Requires official documentation of loss.
Covers theft of souvenirs and personal purchased items. Valuation required for items over $50; police report required for claims.
Provides funds for an emergency return trip home due to family emergencies such as serious illness or death. Limited to one claim per policy period.
Covers loss of income if the insured is deemed totally disabled for 90 consecutive days. Benefits are paid monthly up to $50,000 per year. Excludes conditions resulting from self-inflicted injuries.

Provides partial income replacement if the insured can work part-time due to disability. Benefits capped at 50% of total disability coverage. Excludes pre-existing conditions within the first year of policy.
Covers therapy and vocational training to aid recovery or retraining for a new job role. Includes both physical and occupational therapy. Must be prescribed by a licensed medical professional.

Assists with costs for necessary modifications to the home to accommodate a disability. Coverage includes ramps, bathroom modifications, and widened doorways. Requires pre-approval with a contractor's estimate.
Includes counseling and psychiatric care resulting from disability. Covers up to 20 sessions per year. Services must be provided by licensed practitioners.
Provides a weekly income benefit for up to 6 months if the policyholder is temporarily disabled. Begins after a 14-day waiting period. Excludes disabilities arising out of illegal activities.
Offers monthly benefits for extended disability lasting longer than 6 months. Benefits available until age 65 or recovery. Excludes mental health disabilities unless hospitalized.
Pays a lump sum to the designated beneficiary if the insured dies while on disability. Provided only if the death occurs during the benefit period.
Aids the insured in transitioning back to the workforce with job placement and retraining support. Comprehensive assessment and plan development required. Available twice per policy term.
Premium payments are waived after 90 consecutive days of total disability. Applies only to total disability claims. Premium payment resumes upon recovery.
Covers up to 70% of pre-disability income for total disability. Benefits begin after a 60-day elimination period. Excludes disabilities due to war or armed forces service.
Provides monthly assistance for dependent care costs if the insured is disabled. Covers children under 18 and dependent adults. Requires proof of dependency.
Covers additional costs incurred during hospitalization due to disability. Paid as a lump sum per hospitalization event exceeding 3 days. Excludes cosmetic procedures.
Covers educational courses or degrees required to transition to a new career post-disability. Valid for accredited institutions only. Pre-approval required.
Provides temporary relief for primary caregivers of the insured. Covers professional in-home care services. Offered once annually for up to 14 days.
Offers monthly benefits for life in the event of permanent and total disability. Includes a 180-day waiting period. Excludes alcoholism or drug addiction-related disabilities.
Covers costs for professional consultations and legal services related to disability benefits or care. Requires detailed receipts and service breakdown.
Supports the purchase of adaptive equipment necessary for daily living activities. Includes wheelchairs, communication devices, and custom orthotics. Requires a specialist’s recommendation.
Provides comprehensive mental health support including therapy sessions and medication. Available for conditions directly linked to the disability. Prescription required for medication coverage.
Assists in job placement or training for the spouse of the disabled person if their employment is impacted. Includes career counseling and job search resources.
Provides monthly income for temporary disabilities lasting less than one year. Subject to a 30-day elimination period. Excludes cosmetic surgery recoveries.
Pays a lump sum if the insured is diagnosed with a critical illness defined by the policy. Includes cancer, heart attack, and stroke. Diagnosis must occur after policy commencement.
Provides financial assistance for childcare expenses incurred due to a disability. Valid for children under 12. Requires submission of childcare provider details.
Covers costs for medical transportation services to and from necessary medical appointments. Includes ambulatory services if medically required. Valid for services within 100 miles of residence.
Supports in-home nursing and daily living assistance services during recovery. Requires a physician's certification of need. Limited to a maximum of 12 months per disability.
Covers semi-annual dental exams for all family members. Eligible family members include one primary account holder and up to five dependents. Exams must be conducted by a participating provider.
Includes two cleanings per calendar year per insured member. Coverage is limited to standard cleaning procedures and does not include deep cleaning or periodontal maintenance.
Covers biannual fluoride treatments for children up to the age of 18. Treatments must be recommended by a dentist and performed by a network provider.
Coverage is limited to children under 16 and applies only to permanent molars. Maximum four applications per child per year.
Includes amalgam and composite fillings. Excludes any form of inlays, onlays, or cosmetic fillings.
Covers urgent dental care needs such as pain relief or infection control. Does not include follow-up procedures or elective treatments.
Covers initial evaluation for orthodontic treatment. Coverage restricted to children under 18 and does not cover actual treatment costs.
Includes bitewing X-rays once per year and a full-mouth X-ray every three years. Additional X-rays may not be covered without prior authorization.
Covers one dental examination per year. Services must be rendered by an in-network dentist.
Provides coverage for biannual cleanings. Services limited to standard prophylaxis for adults and children.
Covers one set of bitewing X-rays per year. Additional X-rays require prior approval and are subject to plan limitations.
Includes coverage for amalgam fillings with a limit of two fillings per year. Composite fillings are partially covered.
Covers simple extractions only and excludes surgical extractions or those related to orthodontic purposes.
This covers emergency treatments such as pain relief or temporary restorations. Follow-ups are not included in this coverage.
Annual screening covered once per year for members over 40 or with a family history of oral cancer.
Covers annual dental examinations for insured seniors. Services must be provided by a participating network dentist.
Includes up to two preventive cleanings per year. Excludes deep cleaning or procedures related to periodontal disease.
Covers maintenance visits following periodontal treatment. Limited to three visits per year after active periodontal therapy.
Covers new or replacement full or partial dentures once every five years. Relining or adjustments covered annually.
Covers root canal therapy for molars, premolars, and anterior teeth. Retreatment covered only once per tooth.
Includes coverage for porcelain, metal, or porcelain-fused crowns. Limited to one crown per tooth every seven years.
Covers emergency pain relief treatment. Does not include follow-up care or root canal therapy.
Covers surgical and non-surgical care for oral cancer. Requires prior authorization and is subject to yearly maximums.
Covers one pediatric dental examination per year. Services must be conducted by a pediatric dentist in the network.
Includes biannual cleanings for children under 18. Cleanings beyond this limit require prior authorization.
Sealants are covered for children under the age of 15 on permanent molars only. Reimbursement for lost sealants is not provided.
Includes up to two fluoride treatments per year for children under 18. Treatments must be administered in a dental office.
Covers space maintainers for children who have lost primary teeth prematurely. Limited to once every two years.
Includes coverage for amalgam and composite fillings in children’s teeth. Limited to three fillings per year.
Provides limited coverage for emergency dental incidents involving pediatric patients. Follow-up care is not covered.
Covers initial orthodontic consult for children under 18. Does not cover ongoing orthodontic treatment or aligners.
Covers annual high-end dental examinations. Services must be provided by a select group of elite network specialists.
Unlimited cleanings throughout the year. Does not cover deep cleaning procedures that are deemed medically unnecessary.
Includes coverage for elective cosmetic dental procedures such as whitening and veneers. Requires pre-approval by the plan.
Covers up to two dental implants per year. Consultation and pre-procedure evaluations are covered separately.
Covers adult and adolescent braces or aligners up to the allowed amount. Excludes purely cosmetic alignments without functional necessity.
Coverage includes surgical and non-surgical periodontal treatments. Follow-up maintenance is included within the overall benefit.
Includes coverage for tooth-colored inlays and onlays. Coverage limited to replacement every five years.
Annual coverage for high-resolution imaging such as CT scans. Procedures must be deemed necessary by a qualified dentist.
Covers custom-fitted nightguards once every two years. Coverage contingent upon diagnosis of bruxism or related conditions.
Covers one comprehensive eye exam per year with network providers. Non-network exams are covered up to $45, after which the member pays the difference.
Covers fitting fees for contact lenses up to $60 annually. Any additional fitting costs beyond $60 are the member's responsibility.
Provides up to $100 for single vision lenses once per year. Custom coatings or special materials are not covered.
Covers up to $80 for frames once every two years. Only eligible for frames purchased through network retailers.
Provides a $150 allowance for contact lenses per year instead of glasses. This amount can also be used toward specialty lenses, subject to available allowance.
Offers a 15% discount on LASIK procedures at participating surgeons. Discount is not combinable with other offers.
Anti-reflective and scratch-resistant coatings are available with a $50 copay on covered lenses. Non-standard enhancements aren't included.
Covers one full eye exam per year. Examinations must be conducted by a licensed optometrist within the network for full coverage.
Covers prescription lenses up to $200 once a year, including bifocals and trifocals. Excludes progressive lenses.
Provides up to $150 towards new frames every year. Only frames purchased through network providers are eligible for this benefit.
Allows a $200 annual benefit for contacts in lieu of glasses. Coverage is inclusive of both corrective and cosmetic contacts.
Covers photochromic lenses with a $50 deductible annually. Non-standard brands are excluded from this benefit.
Covers up to $100 towards prescription sunglasses once every two years. Sunglasses must be obtained from in-network providers.
Includes one eye exam per year with a specialist in the network, fully covered. Out-of-network exams are covered at 70% of the usual and customary rate.
Covers the cost of high-index lenses up to $250 annually. This benefit cannot be combined with any other lens discount.
Provides up to $300 for designer frames every year. Frames must be purchased through approved opticians within the network.
Covers up to $300 yearly for contact lenses, including specialty lenses. A fitting session with a network provider is required.
Progressive lenses are covered with a $40 copay. Coverage includes standard progressives, with premium brands incurring additional charges.
Covers specific eye-related medical treatments up to $400 annually, excluding surgery. Treatments must be prescribed by a network provider.
Offers up to $500 for vision therapy per year when deemed medically necessary by an optometrist. Pre-authorization is required.
Provides one comprehensive eye exam annually at no cost when using a preferred provider in the network. Additional exams will incur out-of-pocket expenses.
Covers up to $150 for standard lenses per annum. Specialty coatings are not included within this amount and will require additional payment.
Allows up to $250 for premium frames every two years. Frames purchased out-of-network will be reimbursed at 70% of the purchase price.
Covers varifocal lenses up to $100 with a $20 deductible annually. The coverage excludes high-end or custom varifocal lenses.
Provides up to $200 annually towards orthokeratology, subject to pre-approval. Only treatments conducted by certified professionals are eligible.
Covers preventive and routine eye health screenings up to $150 annually. Screenings must be part of a scheduled eye exam for coverage.
Covers one basic eye exam annually at no charge when services are rendered by an affiliate provider. Non-network exams receive partial reimbursement.
Offers up to $120 towards basic lenses once per year. Specialty lenses and enhancements are excluded from this coverage.
Covers up to $100 for economy frames every two years through network providers. Frames outside this price range are not covered.
Covers disposable contact lenses up to $120 annually. The member is responsible for costs exceeding this allowance.
Covers standard tints and scratch-resistant coatings with a $40 copay. Other enhancements are at the member's expense.
Provides up to $300 for the treatment of vision-related injuries. Services must be pre-authorized and performed by a network provider.
Covers veterinary costs resulting from accidental injuries. Excludes injuries caused by negligence or participation in organized sports or commercial activities.
Includes coverage for treatment of common illnesses such as infections and digestive issues. Excludes pre-existing conditions diagnosed within 12 months prior to policy start.
Covers prescribed medications due to covered illnesses or injuries. Excludes alternative treatments and herbal supplements.
Includes diagnostic imaging needed to diagnose covered conditions. Requires prior authorization for non-emergency procedures.
Available for emergency treatment resulting from accidents or sudden illnesses. Excludes routine check-ups and non-urgent procedures.
Comprehensive coverage for accidents and illnesses, with exclusions for pre-existing conditions and elective procedures.
Covers treatment prescribed by a veterinarian for behavioral issues. Excludes training or therapy for aggression or anxiety unless medically advised.
Covers ongoing treatment of chronic conditions diagnosed after policy inception. Excludes coverage for pre-existing chronic conditions.
Includes visits to veterinary specialists for covered conditions. Specialist referrals must be provided by a primary veterinarian.
Genetic and hereditary conditions are covered if diagnosed after policy start. Testing must be pre-approved to qualify for coverage.
Includes annual check-ups, vaccinations, and flea/tick prevention. Must adhere to specified schedule to remain eligible.
Covers dental cleanings and extractions resulting from accidents. Excludes cosmetic dental work and routine cleanings.
Includes acupuncture, hydrotherapy, and chiropractic care if prescribed by a veterinarian. Excludes treatments not recognized by veterinary boards.
Pays for costs of hospitalization due to illness or injury. Requires pre-approval for non-elective surgeries.
Covers chemotherapy, radiation, and surgery for cancer treatment. Excludes experimental treatments and trials.
Covers medical emergencies while traveling more than 100 miles from home. Excludes planned surgeries and routine care.
Reimburses costs associated with locating a lost pet, such as posters and advertising. Requires proof of microchipping.
Covers boarding costs if owner is hospitalized for more than three days. Requires documentation from both the hospital and boarding facility.
Covers injuries occurring during outdoor activities like hiking or swimming. Excludes injuries from extreme sports or wildlife encounters.
Reimburses the cost of pet theft or straying incidents. Must be reported to authorities within 24 hours of the event.
Covers necessary veterinary care for injuries and illnesses. Excludes elective and preventive care services.
Covers a portion of the cost for spay or neuter surgeries. Excludes advanced reproductive surgeries.
Covers routine vaccinations as per local regulations. Requires adherence to recommended vaccination schedule.
Reimburses cost for microchipping once per pet lifetime. Must be performed by a licensed veterinary professional.
Includes flea, tick, and worm prevention treatments. Excludes treatments not approved by local health regulations.
Covers costs associated with data breaches, including notification expenses, legal fees, and regulatory fines. Excludes breaches due to failure in implementing basic cybersecurity measures.
Covers liability for damages to third parties due to failure of network security. Excludes incidents caused by unencrypted data storage.
Provides coverage for losses and expenses incurred in responding to cyber extortion threats. Payments made are subject to regulatory approvals.
Covers legal and compensatory costs from claims of bodily injury or property damage due to product defects. Excludes wear and tear or intentional misuse cases.
Covers loss of income due to an interruption in business operations resulting from covered perils. Requires proof of income loss and operational downtime.
Covers losses due to theft or damage of inventory. Excludes loss due to natural disasters unless optional coverage is purchased.
Covers costs associated with third-party claims for damages due to pollution conditions. Excludes fines and penalties imposed by governmental bodies.
Covers costs of cleaning up pollution on the insured's premises. Requires immediate reporting and cooperation with environmental agencies.
Covers liability for damages to natural resources due to pollution. Excludes damages that occur outside of policy period.
Covers legal and settlement costs for claims of negligence in medical practice. Requires reporting of all incidents within 30 days.
Covers costs for damages to the physical property of the practice. Excludes damages from normal wear and tear or pre-existing conditions.
Covers loss of crop yields due to natural disasters or adverse weather conditions. Excludes losses due to poor farming practices.
Covers death of livestock due to illness or accident. Requires proof of cause of death and is subject to veterinary examination.
Covers repair or replacement of machinery due to accidental breakdowns. Excludes damage from normal wear and tear or lack of maintenance.

policy_terms.renewal_policy: The policyholder will receive a renewal notice 60 days before the end of the 30-year term. Renewal will be subject to a medical evaluation and may involve an adjustment in premium rates based on the policyholder's age and health status at the time of renewal. The policyholder must provide a written response to confirm renewal at least 30 days before the current term expires. Failure to comply with the renewal notice terms will result in the automatic termination of the policy.
policy_terms.cancellation_policy: The policyholder may cancel the policy at any time by providing a 30-day written notice. If the cancellation occurs within the first 90 days of the policy term, the policyholder is entitled to a full refund of premiums paid. After this period, a pro-rata refund minus a processing fee of $50 will apply. Failure to provide proper notice will result in the forfeiture of any potential refund.

policy_terms.renewal_policy: This whole life policy does not require renewal as it is in effect until the policyholder's death, assuming premiums are paid timely. Premium adjustments may occur annually based on the company's current rate structure and will be communicated at least 90 days in advance. The policyholder will receive an annual summary detailing any adjustments, and must address any disputes before the next billing cycle.
policy_terms.cancellation_policy: Cancellation of this policy requires a 60-day written notice. Any surrender value accumulated will be refunded to the policyholder after deduction of a termination fee, calculated as 2% of the surrender value. No penalties apply if the policy is cancelled within the first 30 days, during which a full refund of premiums paid will be given, but no surrender value is applicable.

policy_terms.renewal_policy: FlexiLife policies are renewable at the end of each term length selected, subject to changes in premium based on age and health assessments. Notifications about the renewal process will be sent 90 days prior to the term's end, and policyholders must submit a renewal application within 45 days of receiving notice. Failure to respond will result in policy expiration, though conversion to whole life insurance is available without additional underwriting.
policy_terms.cancellation_policy: Policyholders can cancel at any time with a 45-day written notice. Full refund of premiums is provided if cancellation is within the initial 60-day period. Beyond this period, a pro-rata refund will be calculated, excluding the administrative fee of $75. Premiums paid are not refundable after conversion to a whole life insurance product.

policy_terms.renewal_policy: Renewal requires both insured parties to undergo health evaluations, with renewal notifications sent 120 days in advance. The policy can be renewed for an additional term or converted to an individual policy upon reaching stipulated term limits. Premium adjustments will be based on the age and health of both insured parties, with a written agreement required 60 days before term expiration to execute renewal.
policy_terms.cancellation_policy: Cancellations require mutual consent from both insured individuals and must be submitted via a joint written notice 30 days prior to the intended cancellation date. A full refund is available if cancellation occurs within the first 90 days. After this period, refunds are pro-rated and reduced by an administrative fee of $100. No refund is available if either policyholder has filed a claim.

policy_terms.renewal_policy: The Carefree Senior Whole Life policy does not include a standard renewal process as it remains effective for the insured's lifetime, assuming all premiums are paid. Any changes in premium structures due to company policy will be communicated annually, with at least a 120-day notice to the policyholder. Policyholders are required to submit written consent if agreeing to any premium adjustments.
policy_terms.cancellation_policy: Policyholders may cancel the policy with a 45-day written notice, and any cash value accumulated will be refunded following a 5% surrender fee deduction. If cancellation occurs within 60 days of policy issuance, a full refund of premiums is granted minus any applicable fees. There is no refund of premiums after cash value exceeds the total premiums paid.

policy_terms.renewal_policy: This policy automatically renews at the end of each term unless canceled by the policyholder or insurer. A formal notice of renewal will be sent 60 days before the expiration date. The premium rate may be adjusted at renewal based on claim history and age of insured members. Policyholders must confirm renewal in writing 30 days before the term ends.
policy_terms.cancellation_policy: To cancel this policy, a written notice is required 30 days before the desired cancellation date. The policyholder will receive a prorated refund of the premium paid, minus a cancellation fee of 10%. If claims have been made within the policy term, additional charges may apply. In the event of non-payment, the policy may be canceled by the insurer with a 15-day notice.

policy_terms.renewal_policy: Policies renew automatically unless notice is provided by either party. Renewal notifications will be issued 45 days prior to policy expiration. Premiums may be adjusted based on age, health status, and regional healthcare cost trends. The policyholder must notify their intent to renew or cancel within 15 days of receiving the renewal notice.
policy_terms.cancellation_policy: Cancellation requires a 30-day written notice from the policyholder. Upon cancellation, a refund will be provided on a pro-rata basis, subject to a 15% administrative fee. If claims have been made, no refund is available. The insurer reserves the right to cancel with a 30-day notice due to non-compliance or non-payment.

policy_terms.renewal_policy: This policy is set for automatic renewal unless the policyholder informs otherwise. A renewal notification will be dispatched 60 days prior to the policy end date, outlining any changes in terms or premiums. Adjustments to premiums may occur to reflect any changes in healthcare inflation rates or policyholder demographics. Policyholders must respond within 20 days of the renewal notice.
policy_terms.cancellation_policy: Policyholders may cancel their policy by providing a 30-day written notice. A full refund is available if canceled within the first 10 days of policy issuance, beyond which a pro-rated refund, less a 20% cancellation fee, will be calculated. The insurer can initiate cancellation for reasons including fraud or non-payment, providing a minimum 20-day notice.

policy_terms.renewal_policy: This policy automatically renews annually unless a 30-day advance notice is provided by the policyholder. A renewal letter will be issued 75 days before the current term ends. Premiums may be revised to reflect actuarial projections, inflation, or age-related risk factors. Policyholders need to confirm their renewal decision 25 days before their current policy expires.
policy_terms.cancellation_policy: Cancellation requires a 45-day notice in writing by the policyholder. A refund will be given, prorated based on the unused portion of the term, minus a 25% processing fee. Claims made will affect refund eligibility. The insurer may cancel the policy with a minimum 30-day notice if conditions such as fraudulent claims are detected.

policy_terms.renewal_policy: Automatically renews at the end of each coverage period unless canceled by either party, with a renewal notice sent 60 days ahead. Premium adjustments can occur in line with industry standards and any changes in the insured's health conditions. Policyholders must provide a written acknowledgment of renewal 20 days before the end of the term.
policy_terms.cancellation_policy: To cancel, policyholders must submit a written notice 30 days in advance. A pro-rata refund will be issued, deducting a 20% cancellation fee, provided no claims have been filed. In cases of fraud or consistent late payment, the insurer reserves the right to cancel the policy with a 30-day notice.

policy_terms.renewal_policy: The SafeDrive Elite Comprehensive policy automatically renews at the end of each term unless canceled by either party. Policyholders will receive a renewal notice 45 days prior to the expiration date detailing any changes in premium or terms. Premium adjustments may occur based on driving history, inflation, and market conditions. Policyholders must confirm any changes by their specified due date to ensure uninterrupted coverage.
policy_terms.cancellation_policy: Policyholders may cancel the SafeDrive Elite Comprehensive policy at any time by providing a written notice 30 days in advance. A pro-rata refund of the premium will be issued minus a processing fee of $50 if the policy is canceled within the first 60 days. No refund will be provided for cancellations made in the last month of the coverage term.

policy_terms.renewal_policy: EcoMiles Green Protection offers automatic renewal subject to policyholder approval 30 days before term expiration. A renewal notice, inclusive of any premium changes reflective of eco-driving performance and claims history, will be sent 60 days ahead. Continued use of eco-friendly vehicles may entitle policyholders to discounts, which will be reflected in the renewal offer. Non-response may result in automatic renewal with prior terms.
policy_terms.cancellation_policy: Cancellation requests for EcoMiles Green Protection must be submitted in writing at least 45 days before the desired cancellation date. Full refunds are issued if cancellation is within the first 30 days, and a pro-rata refund applies thereafter, minus a $75 administrative fee. Early cancellation within the renewal term may also lead to forfeiture of any earned green discounts.

policy_terms.renewal_policy: UrbanShield Metro Focus policies renew annually unless a written non-renewal notice is received. Renewal notices will be distributed 50 days prior to expiration, clearly listing any premium modifications due to urban risk factors or claim history. Premiums are adjusted based on metropolitan risk valuation and past incidents. Continued payment ensures seamless renewal.
policy_terms.cancellation_policy: For cancellations, UrbanShield Metro Focus requires a 30-day written notice. Cancellations within the first policy month grant a full refund less a $100 setup fee. Afterward, a calculated refund based on premium used will be made, minus a $100 administrative charge. Policies canceled without notice may incur an additional penalty equal to 10% of the remaining premium.

policy_terms.renewal_policy: YoungDriver Smart Start renews annually, automatically if no cancellation notice is received. A renewal communication will be sent 30 days before the policy end, highlighting any premium increases due to age-based adjustments or driving record changes. Awareness of upcoming premium changes is crucial for policyholders to decide on renewal. Non-action assumes agreement to renewed terms.
policy_terms.cancellation_policy: The YoungDriver Smart Start policy can be canceled by sending a written notification 14 days before the desired termination date. Cancellations done within 14 days from the inception date receive a full premium reimbursement. Afterward, policyholders receive a pro-rata refund less a $50 cancellation fee, unless the policy has less than a month remaining, in which case no refund is offered.

policy_terms.renewal_policy: RuralGuard Agri-Coverage automatically renews at the end of each term unless a cancellation request is issued. Policyholders are notified of renewal terms and any premium changes 60 days prior to expiration. Premiums may adjust based on rural risk assessments and claims experience. Policyholders must acknowledge any alterations to continue coverage effectively.
policy_terms.cancellation_policy: For RuralGuard Agri-Coverage, cancelations necessitate a 60-day prior written notice. A complete refund is possible if canceled within the first 30 days, minus an administrative fee of $55. Beyond this, refunds are prorated based on coverage used, minus a $55 fee. Cancellation penalties apply if policy is terminated without requisite notice, amounting to 15% of the remaining premium.

policy_terms.renewal_policy: The HomeGuard Plus policy automatically renews at the end of each term unless the policyholder provides a written notice 30 days prior to the expiration date. Premium adjustments will be made based on claims history, inflation rates, and underwriting criteria applicable at the time of renewal. Policyholders will receive an updated policy document outlining any changes at least 45 days before renewal. Failure to make premium payments by the due date will result in the lapse of coverage.
policy_terms.cancellation_policy: Policyholders may cancel the HomeGuard Plus policy at any time by providing a written notice 15 days in advance. A pro-rata refund of unearned premium will be processed if no claims have been filed during the current policy term. If a claim has been filed, cancellation may still proceed, but a penalty equivalent to one month's premium will be deducted from the refund. The insurer reserves the right to cancel the policy for non-payment or fraud with written notice 60 days in advance.

policy_terms.renewal_policy: SafeNest Essentials policies are automatically renewed annually, with notifications sent 60 days before the renewal date. Premiums may be adjusted annually based on factors such as local housing market trends and the policyholder's claims history. The policyholder has the option to opt out of automatic renewal by notifying the insurer at least 30 days prior to the policy expiry. Updated policy terms and premium notices will be provided 45 days before the renewal.

faqs.question: What is the maximum coverage limit for the SecureLife Premium Term 30 policy?
faqs.answer: The SecureLife Premium Term 30 policy offers coverage limits ranging from $100,000 to $1,000,000, allowing you to choose the amount that best fits your family’s financial security needs. faqs.question: Can I add a critical illness rider to my SecureLife Premium Term 30 policy?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can add a critical illness rider to your SecureLife Premium Term 30 policy. This rider provides a lump sum benefit if you are diagnosed with a critical illness specified in the policy, such as cancer, heart attack, or stroke. This benefit can be used to cover medical expenses, supplement income during recovery, or meet other financial obligations. Adding this rider will increase your premium. Please speak with an agent to understand the specific illnesses covered and the additional cost.

faqs.question: Is suicide covered under the SecureLife Premium Term 30 policy?
faqs.answer: SecureLife Premium Term 30 includes a standard suicide exclusion clause applicable within the first two policy years. If the insured commits suicide within this period, the policy’s death benefit will not be paid; however, premiums paid may be refunded to beneficiaries. After this period, the death benefit is typically payable unless otherwise specified. Always read the policy terms carefully for details on exclusions.

faqs.question: How can I adjust my premium payments if my financial situation changes?
faqs.answer: With SecureLife Premium Term 30, you have the flexibility to adjust your premium payments through various options, such as changing payment frequency or reducing coverage to lower premiums. These adjustments can accommodate changes in your financial situation. It's important to consult with your insurance advisor to understand how these changes impact your coverage and to ensure continued compliance with your financial protection goals.

faqs.question: What happens if I miss a premium payment?
faqs.answer: If you miss a premium payment on your SecureLife Premium Term 30 policy, a grace period of 30 days is usually provided, during which your policy remains in force. If the payment is not made by the end of the grace period, the policy may lapse, and coverage could be terminated. To reinstate the policy, you might need to pay the overdue amount and possibly provide evidence of insurability. Always contact your insurance provider immediately if you anticipate payment difficulties.

faqs.question: Does the SecureLife Premium Term 30 policy include coverage for accidental death?
faqs.answer: The SecureLife Premium Term 30 policy primarily provides a guaranteed death benefit for any cause of death, including natural causes. However, accidental death is covered like any other cause within the terms of the policy. For enhanced coverage specifically for accidental death, you can elect an additional accidental death benefit rider, which will provide an extra payout in case of death by accident. This rider requires additional premium.

faqs.question: Are pre-existing conditions covered under the SecureLife Premium Term 30 plan?
faqs.answer: Coverage for pre-existing conditions under the SecureLife Premium Term 30 often depends on the underwriting results. While a pre-existing condition may not automatically disqualify you from getting coverage, it might affect your premiums or coverage limits. Full disclosure during the application process is crucial, and you might be subject to exclusion for specific conditions. It’s recommended to discuss your health history with an insurance advisor to understand all implications.

faqs.question: What is not included in the SecureLife Premium Term 30 insurance policy?
faqs.answer: The SecureLife Premium Term 30 insurance policy excludes certain situations such as death resulting from illegal activities, acts of war, or during the commission of a felony. Additionally, suicide within the first two policy years is excluded. Optional riders can expand coverage to include critical illnesses and accidental death, but these are not covered under the basic policy. Review your policy document for a detailed list of exclusions.

faqs.question: Can I convert my SecureLife Premium Term 30 policy to a permanent life insurance policy?
faqs.answer: SecureLife Premium Term 30 offers a conversion option that allows you to convert your term policy to a permanent life insurance policy without additional medical underwriting, typically up to a specified age, often around 70 years. faqs.question: How do I update my beneficiary information on the SecureLife Premium Term 30 policy?
